svg.title: AHMED ZAKI: Cinematic Web · Webgl
svg.desc: A scroll story shot like a film, opening into three 3D worlds: Product, AI and Full Stack. Built with React · Vite · GSAP · Lenis · WebGL. Opens ahmedzaki.vercel.app.
